senses.gloss: f. (an adaptation of furnus, φοῦρνος, as if from פָּרַן) [the supplier,] a stationary, large baking oven, contrad. to תנור.
units: Pes. 31ᵇ פת פ׳ bread baked in the purni (large loaves).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 35b:16">Ab. Zar. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>פת פ׳ מאפה סאה</he> bread of an oven of a batch of a S’ah of flour; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:9">Kel. VIII, 9</cite> <cite ref="Q00359"><he>פּוּרְנָה</he></cite> an earthen oven; <cite ref="Tosefta Kelim Kamma 6:17">Tosef. Kel. B. Kam. VI, 17</cite> <cite ref="Q01881"><he>פּוּרְנָא</he></cite>.
